title: Ruth Works in the Field
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler with the big, brave heart that gets up and does the hard thing, and tonight Ruth goes out to glean all day so Naomi can eat: Beau picks up a whole floor of toys, again and again, while Mom is sick.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because working hard for someone you love takes a big, brave heart. In Beau’s world today: Mom is sick on the couch, and the living room floor is covered with toys. Nobody asks him, but Beau gets the big basket. Bend down, pick up, put in the basket, again and again, until his arms are tired and the floor is clear. Mom smiles and says, “You worked so hard for me.” Just like Ruth gathering grain all day for Naomi, Beau learned that hard work is one way to say I love you.
